title: Irrealis Concessive Conditionals: még ha ... is / még ha ... volna is ('even if ... were / had been')

sections.title: Hypothetical and Counterfactual Concession
sections.content: You know *még ha ... is* and *még ha ... volna is* from B2 Unit 27; here you use them for the borderland cities. To express hypothetical or counterfactual concession in the present or future, use még ha with a conditional verb followed by the emphatic particle is: 'Még ha akadályok merülnének is fel, a híd összekötné a két partot' (Even if obstacles were to arise, the bridge would connect the two banks). For past counterfactual concession, put volna in both clauses, the main clause too: 'Még ha viták kísérték volna is az építkezést, a hidat átadták volna' (Even if debates had accompanied the construction, the bridge would have been opened).

sections.title: Placement of the Particle 'is'
sections.content: The particle 'is' attaches to the verb or predicate element bearing the contrastive emphasis: 'Még ha szigorúak lennének is a szabályok...' (Even if the rules were strict...). Without 'is', the sentence is still a correct 'even if' sentence, but 'is' makes the concession more emphatic.

sections.title: Present vs. Past Concessive Conditionals
rows: Még ha szigorúbbak lennének is a nyelvtörvények, a közösség kitartana.
Even if language laws were stricter, the community would persevere.
Még ha viták alakultak volna is ki, a megállapodást aláírták volna.
Even if debates had developed, they would have signed the agreement.
Még ha nehéz lenne is az ingázás, sokan vállalnák a munkát.
Even if commuting were difficult, many would undertake the work.
Még ha drága lett volna is a beruházás, a hidat megépítették volna.
Even if the investment had been expensive, they would have built the bridge.

items.spanish: Még ha kevesebb támogatást kapnának is, a vajdasági művelődési egyesületek folytatnák a munkát.
items.english: Even if they were to receive less subsidy, the Vojvodina cultural associations would continue their work.

items.spanish: Még ha hosszabb időt vett volna is igénybe, a kétnyelvű táblák kihelyezése elengedhetetlen lett volna.
items.english: Even if it had taken a longer time, mounting the bilingual signs would have been indispensable.

items.spanish: Még ha nehézségek merülnének is fel a határon, a kulturális kapcsolatok nem szakadnának meg.
items.english: Even if difficulties were to arise at the border, cultural ties would not be severed.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: With a conditional verb, put 'is' after it: 'még ha [ige-feltételes] is'. In the past, use 'volna' in both clauses: 'Még ha kérték volna is, nem tették volna meg.'
